question: In September 2025, the South Western Railway (SWR) reported that its Railway Protection Force (RPF) had reached out to more than two lakh women passengers under which of the following initiative, aimed at ensuring safety and comfort for women traveling alone?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation Meri Saheli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Operation Meri Saheli** is an initiative launched by the **Railway Protection Force (RPF)** with the aim of ensuring the safety and comfort of **women passengers traveling alone**.
 
• It was started in **October 2020** by the Indian Railways to provide **round-the-clock safety** for women passengers during their train journey.
 
• Under this operation, RPF personnel reach out to women passengers during train journeys, provide necessary safety tips, and ensure assistance in case of distress. 
 
• The initiative involves **dedicated teams of RPF personnel**, specifically tasked with monitoring and interacting with women passengers to ensure their safety.
 
• In **September 2025**, South Western Railway (SWR) reported that its RPF had reached out to more than **two lakh women passengers** under Operation Meri Saheli.
 
• This initiative has been commended for its proactive approach to addressing security concerns for women traveling alone,
